findings.summary: The hook fixture now tests a reminder sent at the chosen local hour, but criterion C.webapp.prompts.bounded's claim still covers only five ordered cards and duplicate-job deduplication, so the hook checks something its criterion does not state.
C.webapp.prompts.bounded is an acceptance criterion for evolution.2, but optional reminder transport arrives only in evolution.4, so evolution.2 cannot pass the extended fixture.
The new localHour field has no 0..23 range, and the entity description does not mention it, unlike the bounded int types used elsewhere (e.g. intervalDays 1..3650).
